Embark on a melodious journey with "Mishra Khamaj," a captivating exploration of the enchanting Indian classical Raag Khamaj. This video delves into the intricate nuances and emotive expressions of this beautiful raag, blending both traditional and contemporary elements.

Artist: Pt. Hariprasad Chauraisa
